research.notes: No credible candidate found. The agenda gives only the name 'GroundWorks' (no city), for a Measure N item at Oakland Technical High School. Web searches for GroundWorks tied to Oakland Tech, Measure N or OUSD returned nothing, and the OUSD Measure N 2023-24 annual report does not mention it. Many similarly named organizations exist (Groundwork USA trust chapters, Groundworks in other states), so a match could not be confirmed.
